name: Lionheart Fixt
author: vkays
description: A cumulative restoration-and-repair mod for Lionheart, after Fallout Fixt. Releases 0.1.0 'The Horde', 0.1.1 'The Crossroads Patrol', 0.1.2 'Standing', 0.1.4 'What Playtesting Found' 0.2.0 'What Was Written', 0.2.1, 0.3.0 'The Knights of Saladin' 0.4.0 'Quinn's Reagents', 0.5.1 'The Thieves' Guild', 0.6.0 'The Port District', 0.7.0 'The Road North', 0.8.0 'The Gate District Remainder' 0.8.1 through 0.8.4, repair releases, 0.9.0 'The Temple District', 0.9.1 'Around Barcelona', 0.9.2 through 0.9.4, repair releases, 0.10.0 'Montserrat', 0.10.1 through 0.10.3, repair releases, and 0.11.0 'The Prisoner of Montserrat'. The goblins of the Wilderness are the most developed evil content in the game and in vanilla they feed nothing; Fixt makes the Horde a real faction with three accumulating ranks on the shipped Saladin/Templar pattern, puts back two finished characters that shipped with zero map references, and restores dialogue the original writers finished and the scripters never wired -- the Goblin Girl's cut follow behaviour, the Khan's war campaign against Barcelona, and Grumdjum's post-dryad conversation. Every check adds a route and none removes one, so the vanilla solution to every scene still works. 0.3.0 connects the Knights of Saladin's title to their rank, unlocking twenty replies across four acts, and restores the Sacred Scimitar questline -- fully authored, unstartable, and broken at all three ends. 0.4.0 is the project's first new content: three errands for Quinn the herbalist, each unlocking a healing potion tier above vanilla's Extra Healing. 0.4.1 is repair only: a structural DialogTree defect that had been silently disabling replies since 0.2.0, and two of 0.4.0's three reagent errands that could never be started. 0.5.0 'The Thieves' Guild' is the Sewers: Juanita's cut final job restored in a house built for it -- the project's first new map -- with the guard, the cell and the fee that follow being caught; the thieves' vault switched on as a real heist with five ways past its door; and Juanita's fee made unavoidable. The thieves ship four jobs to the beggars' five, pay no gold at all where Enrique pays about six hundred, and their fifth job was written, wired and left with nowhere to happen. 0.5.1 repairs two fatal crashes in 0.5.0, which was built but never published: a chest placed with an invented model path, and the same chest set to an animation its model does not have. Both killed the game on entering the vault. tools/validate.py now checks every Model= exists and every Cur Sequence= is one vanilla uses for that model; both checks were written against the real crashes. It also fixes a guard who attacked after the Speech check passed, because the reply stood down his generator rather than the man. 0.8.0 finishes the Gate District and stops there: the district's 42 orphaned replies drop to 34 and the surviving 34 are individually accounted for, none of them a cut quest. Its one real restoration is DaVinci's spirit-gem branch -- he answers being told the Inquisition has the gem, that node roots a live three-node branch holding the choice of whether to cross the Inquisition for him, and no reply led to it. Weng Choi's special-customer greeting could never fire because the conditional guarding it opens the same node on both arms, the same shape as 0.7.0's Ways Crystal. Merchant Lope's written Perception haggle was offered from nowhere and now sits beside the intimidation and Barter routes. The goblin sapper can be asked his name. Two return greetings opened their first-meeting node, the third and fourth instance of the bug 0.3.0 found on Farshad. Four further candidates were read and deliberately left alone as superseded drafts, including the Blacksmith's orphaned turn-in hub, which pays nothing a reachable node does not already pay. 0.8.1 is repair only, from the first play of three earlier features: Fernand's healing potion is now a quest item the rescue checks for by name, so it can no longer consume whatever potion the player happens to carry, and Fernand keeps acknowledging the rescue instead of forgetting it after the first time; the lava trolls are pacified at the moment they spawn rather than up to two seconds later, which closes the race that left one troll hostile at the far end of the pit; and the Helpful Wererat is named as such in conversation and turns with the rest of the beggars when they turn. 0.8.2 is repair only, from the first play of Quinn's reagent errands: a leftover test reply is removed, completed errands are no longer offered again, a turn-in with too few reagents no longer consumes them or plays the success text, the quality-pelt fix now applies from every greeting rather than one, and his reserve opens on completed errands rather than a counter that most greetings never advanced. Fernand's draught is also drinkable, so saving Juan costs a real potion. 0.8.3 repairs the Knights of Saladin: Amir now offers his Montserrat directions to a Favored One, on the greeting he actually uses after the trials, and the trials no longer strip a sworn Inquisitor or Templar of their order -- a character can hold only one faction, so Saladin content now keys on the Crescent title rather than the faction. 0.8.4 makes every skull sold to the fish monger count toward his hidden perk: bartered sales and the reduced-price sales after he declares himself full were never counted, so the fifteenth skull could not be reached. 0.9.0 is the Temple District and the first work in Act 3: an Inquisitor finally hears Torquemada's own acknowledgment for the Goblin Khan instead of the outsider's; Machiavelli keeps his promise or his threat in Montaillou, where he was on no map at all -- refuse him in Barcelona and he sells you to the Old Man's assassins at the inn, save him and he repays you; Na Roqua greets a friend of the Cathars as one, and admits she once hunted beside the shapeshifting daeva, on two voiced nodes vanilla wrote and never wired; Sir Auric sponsors a tainted initiate in the words written for one, Lord Javier tells an unsponsored petitioner to seek Auric, and Cervantes remembers you. Torquemada's own quest to purify the shadow dryad is read and left unfinished, with the reason: she cannot be killed. 0.9.1 is the areas around Barcelona: the Mongol Camp's gate guard greets a player the camp has welcomed instead of falling silent for the rest of the game, and the Irish sailor at the Port District tavern notices a down-on-their-luck drinker and hands over the clover from drowned Ireland -- a line, an icon and a Luck check the game shipped and never connected. Seven other leads around Barcelona were read and recorded as drafts. 0.9.2 is repair only, to the Port District's Fernand and Juan: Fernand now hands out his own draught (0.8.1 had repointed the Mute Sailor's reward instead), Juan spawns as a dying man rather than a corpse so the body-draining skills cannot take him and soft-lock the quest, his thanks plays before he moves, the bleed-out warns at twenty seconds, and the brothers' reunion the game wrote and never played -- Fernand's 'Claro que si!' -- plays, with three new lines of Fernand chiding him. 0.9.3 is repair only: the Vodyanoi Anatomist perk, which had never done anything, now adds 4-10 piercing to every landed hit on a vodyanoi regardless of weapon, and the Strength and Barter routes past the goblin holding the woodcutter's daughter get answers that no longer assume the player knows the Khan. 0.9.4 is a hotfix: 0.9.1's Mongol Camp gate crashed the game on entering the camp (a class name led by tabs), fixed and now caught by validate.py; and four repairs from the second playthrough -- the Knights of Saladin's cathedral summit plays and ends, Enrique's red-ore argument opens after the trade completes, the troll chief gives a hide to the player who spoke for him, and Enrique still asks for the wererat cure after his contract is withdrawn. 0.10.0 is Montserrat, the act that shipped as five maps and one conversation: human assassins and snakebreed priestesses in the packs; the Templar captain's journal at the gate, carried to whoever sent you; a wounded assassin who talks; Sahar, the rearguard's captain, with phases before Montgomerie; a mid-hall ambush, a poison tripwire, a sentry who calls for help, a trapped chest; the sanctum re-dressed as an abbey with ten hover-text stops and the monks' absence noted; and seven build levers from Sneak to the Inquisition's sealed order. Also Quinn's shop absorbing his reserve, the Desoto brothers' reunion, Juan as a dying man rather than a corpse, the Vodyanoi Anatomist perk finally working, and the Knights of Saladin's cathedral summit playing to its end. 0.10.1 is repair only: the five chests in the thieves' guild's secret stashes turned the whole guild hostile on a silent Sneak check with no line of sight and no word said; they now bark on failure and on success, both logged, and need a living thief on the map to raise the alarm, as the goblin houses' chests already did. 0.10.2 is repair only: the Inquisition jailor's Rites of Confession -- an Inquisitor's training arc with prisoners to question and a three-tier Speech lesson, built end to end and unreachable because the checker its return reply requires was never activated -- can be completed; the Templar inspection route is once-only as written; and 0.10.0's needle trap plays its sprung bark. 0.10.3 is repair only: the Templar initiation survives Esteban's death through Javier's own line, and Auric and Javier remember being attacked. 0.11.0 is The Prisoner of Montserrat: a way through the invasion that is not a fight against every pack. Give yourself up at the gate and be searched -- named weapons come back exactly, the rest as plain steel -- or keep your arms on Outwit or as one of the Master's own; wake in a new map, the abbey's undercroft, with five ways out of the cell (the lock, the pins, the handler, the drain an old monk tells you about, or wait for the escort); a garrison that stands down for a delivery and hunts a loud escape; Sahar with three ends, the third her word to carry north and a ring that Michel, Machiavelli and the Crypt's assassins each read differently; the rout on her death. Also the trolls' ore chest, the thieves' stash chests, and a Wasp Queen in the Grove's nest -- the project's first authored model. 0.10.3 is repair only: the Templar initiation survives Esteban's death through Javier's own written line, and Auric and Javier both remember being attacked -- the cathedral posting the extra guard its map built for it -- where before the maps reset and forgot.
